parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the returned page. For example, to query the results on the first page, enter **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records displayed on each page.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance in Resource Management. The default value is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.
